description: Toolholder types with total indicated runout (TIR) at the tool tip, as published by manufacturers or taken from DIN 6499. Used by toolwiz_common/tooling_advisor.py. Lengths: tir_mm / tir_in are the published maximum TIR at the stated measuring distance; where the source publishes a range by clamping diameter it is kept in tir_by_clamp_mm. Nothing here is measured by ToolWiz.

schema_notes.tir_mm: Largest published TIR at the tool tip (mm). Used as the holder's worst case by the advisor.
schema_notes.tir_in: Same value in inches (tir_mm / 25.4, rounded to 0.00001).
schema_notes.measured_at: Distance from the holder/collet nose at which the manufacturer measures TIR (D = test-bar diameter).
schema_notes.capability_class: ultra: published TIR <= 0.00015 in. precision: <= 0.0003 in. standard: larger.
schema_notes.rigidity: stiff = reinforced body, suited to heavy side load; medium; light = slim/micro body, finishing and small tools.
schema_notes.bt30: Availability of a BT30 interface from the cited manufacturer, as evidenced by the cited page.
schema_notes.clamp_mm: [min, max] shank diameter in mm from the cited clamping range (SK: 0.028-1 in; micro chuck: Mega New Baby 0.25-20 mm). Used only to check that the tool shank fits.
schema_notes.label: Display name used in holder_advice lists.

REGOFIX_ER.label: Rego-Fix, ER System catalog COL1125 01/2015, page 2 'Concentricity T.I.R. DIN 6499 / ISO 15488' (table of T.I.R. max. by clamping range)

REGOFIX_CAT.label: Rego-Fix, ER System / Product catalog, page 4: powRgrip total system TIR <= 3 um at 3 x D; ER standard collets <= 10 um at 3 x D; ER-UP <= 5 um at 3 x D; micRun total system TIR <= 3 um at 3 x D

REGOFIX_PG.label: Rego-Fix, powRgrip system overview (total system runout <= 3 um at 3 x D; guarantee TIR <= 0.0001 in)

HAIMER_TH.label: HAIMER Tool Holders catalog (US), 'Overview of tool holder technology' table: runout at 3xD, max rpm, balancing grade, clamping range for shrink-fit, power collet, hydraulic, milling, Weldon and ER chucks

HAIMER_TOP10.label: HAIMER, Top 10 reasons to use shrink fit technology: '< 3 um run-out at 3xD', balance G2.5 @ 25,000 rpm

HAIMER_BT30_SHRINK.label: HAIMER Shrink Fit Chuck, JIS B 6339-2 BT30 (product page)

HAIMER_BT30_HYD.label: HAIMER Power Hydraulic Chuck, JIS B 6339, BT30 (product page)

SCHUNK_TENDO.label: SCHUNK TENDO E compact: runout < 0.003 mm (0.0001 in) at 2.5 x D (trade-press release quoting the manufacturer)

BIGK_V6.label: BIG KAISER Vol. 6 Product Guide, pages 19-21: Mega Micro / Mega New Baby collets guaranteed max runout .00004 in at collet nose and .00012 in (3 um) at 4xD; Air Power Spindle RBX5/RBX7/RBX12

BIGK_MEGA_MICRO.label: BIG DAISHOWA, Mega Micro Chuck product page (BIG-PLUS BT30 variants listed)

BIGK_TIPS_MILL.label: BIG DAISHOWA tips: correct clamping of mechanical milling chucks ('greater clamping force at the expense of greater runout')

LYNDEX_SK.label: Lyndex-Nikken SK collet chuck article: 5 um runout tolerance for precision collets; 8-degree collet

NAKANISHI_HES510.label: Nakanishi HES510-BT30 motor spindle: 5,000-50,000 rpm, 340 W, collet 0.5-6.35 mm, spindle accuracy within 1 um

INGERSOLL_TYPHOON.label: Ingersoll Typhoon spindle brochure (BT30 among adaptions; coolant-driven, GJET 290-580 psi)

INGERSOLL_JET_OPS.label: Ingersoll Typhoon HSM Jet Spindle operating conditions (20-40 bar coolant through spindle, 12 L/min, main spindle locked, finishing/semi-finishing, tools to 4.0 mm)

holders.name: standard ER collet
holders.label: standard ER collet
holders.measured_at: length L from collet face per DIN 6499 / ISO 15488 Form B table (L = 6 to 60 mm by collet size)
holders.clamping_range: ER8 to ER50, shank 0.2 to 36 mm (Rego-Fix)
holders.rigidity_notes: Mechanical collet and nut; adequate for general milling. Rego-Fix's own ER collets are rated tighter than DIN (<= 10 um at 3 x D).
holders.balance_notes: Collet and nut add imbalance at the nose; HAIMER lists its ER chuck at G2.5 @ 25,000 rpm and a rating up to 15,000 rpm. Use balanced nuts above about 8,000 rpm.
holders.bt30_evidence: ER holders are offered in BT30 by multiple makers (e.g. Rego-Fix BT30 range via distributors, BIG Kaiser BBT30 ER chucks).

holders.name: ultra-precision ER collet (ER-UP)
holders.label: ultra-precision ER collet (ER-UP)
holders.measured_at: length L from collet face per table (<= 5 um at 3 x D per Rego-Fix catalog p.4)
holders.clamping_range: same as standard ER (ER8 to ER50)
holders.rigidity_notes: Same body and nut as a standard ER holder; only the collet is tighter, so total runout still depends on the nut, holder and cleanliness.
holders.balance_notes: As standard ER; use a balanced (Hi-Q or equivalent) nut at speed.

holders.name: SK/SKC precision collet chuck
holders.label: SK/SKC precision collet
holders.measured_at: not stated in the cited article
holders.rigidity_notes: 8-degree collet sits deeper in the body than a 16-degree ER collet, giving a slimmer, stiffer nose (manufacturer statement). The 'SKC' designation was not found in a manufacturer source and is not relied on.
holders.balance_notes: Not stated in the cited article.
holders.bt30_evidence: Lyndex-Nikken sells SK collet chucks on steep-taper and BT interfaces (SK chuck product page lists BT shanks; page returned 403 to the fetcher, so BT30 is the least certain entry).

holders.name: milling chuck (needle-bearing mechanical chuck)
holders.label: milling chuck
holders.rigidity_notes: High clamping force and large body for heavy roughing; manufacturers note mechanical milling chucks trade some runout for clamping force.
holders.balance_notes: HAIMER lists milling chucks as 'partially fine balanced' with a 15,000 rpm rating; check the balance grade of the specific holder before running near 16,000 rpm.
holders.bt30_evidence: Mechanical milling chucks are sold in BT30 by several makers; HAIMER does not deliver them.

holders.name: Weldon / side-lock holder
holders.label: Weldon/side-lock holder
holders.rigidity_notes: Set-screw on a flat prevents pull-out but pushes the tool off centre, so runout is poor. Not suited to anything that needs low TIR.
holders.balance_notes: HAIMER lists G2.5 @ 22,000 rpm for Weldon and G6.3 @ 8,000 rpm for whistle-notch holders.

holders.name: hydraulic chuck
holders.label: hydraulic
holders.measured_at: 2.5 x D (SCHUNK TENDO E compact), 3 x D (HAIMER table)
holders.rigidity_notes: Good vibration damping and very easy to use. Manufacturers of shrink-fit and mechanical chucks report that hydraulic chucks could not prevent tool pull-out in heavy titanium and aluminum roughing tests (HAIMER catalog, Safe-Lock case study, a competing-vendor claim). Prefer shrink fit, powRgrip or a milling chuck for heavy side-load roughing; hydraulic suits finishing, drilling, reaming and light milling.
holders.balance_notes: HAIMER table: G2.5 @ 25,000 rpm, rated to 40,000 rpm. Needs periodic membrane check and leak test.
holders.bt30_evidence: HAIMER and BIG Kaiser list hydraulic chucks in BT30 (JIS B 6339).

holders.name: shrink fit
holders.label: shrink fit
holders.clamping_range: 3 to 32 mm standard; 6 to 32 mm Power Shrink; 3 to 16 mm Power Mini (HAIMER)
holders.rigidity_notes: Slim, no moving parts, high gripping torque; HAIMER lists the Power and Heavy Duty shrink chucks for roughing. Needs a shrink machine (induction heater) and one shank-diameter bore per tool size.
holders.balance_notes: G2.5 @ 25,000 rpm with the best balance repeatability of any holder type (HAIMER); rated to 50,000 rpm.
holders.bt30_evidence: HAIMER lists shrink-fit chucks in JIS B 6339-2 BT30.

holders.name: Rego-Fix powRgrip
holders.label: powRgrip
holders.clamping_range: 0.2 to 25.4 mm shank, h6 tolerance (PG collets)
holders.rigidity_notes: Press-fit system with torque transfer up to 1,100 Nm and vibration damping (Rego-Fix). Requires the powRgrip press unit.
holders.balance_notes: Rego-Fix quotes balanced colletholders; check the grade of the specific BT30 holder.
holders.bt30_evidence: Distributor listings show BT30 x PG15 and BT30 x PG25 powRgrip holders (secondary source).

holders.name: micro collet chuck (BIG Kaiser Mega Micro / Mega New Baby, Rego-Fix micRun)
holders.label: micro collet chuck (Mega Micro)
holders.measured_at: BIG Kaiser: 1 um (.00004 in) at collet nose and 3 um (.00012 in) at 4 x D; Rego-Fix micRun: 3 um at 3 x D total system
holders.clamping_range: Mega Micro collets 0.5 to 8 mm (0.018 to 0.317 in); micRun 1 to 20 mm
holders.rigidity_notes: Super-slim nose for micro tools and tight clearance; not meant for heavy side load or tools above about 8 mm.
holders.balance_notes: BIG Kaiser states chucks are balanced on a dynamic balancing machine and pairs them with air spindles up to 80,000 rpm; no numeric balance grade found.
holders.bt30_evidence: BIG-PLUS BT30 variants (e.g. BBT30-MEGA3S) are listed on the Mega Micro page.

speed_attachments.name: Air Power Spindle RBX5 / RBX7 / RBX12
speed_attachments.drive: air turbine fed through a stop block or the machine spindle; main spindle need not rotate
speed_attachments.bt30: BBT30 (BIG-PLUS) listed in the BIG DAISHOWA BBT30 catalog; confirm BIG-PLUS vs standard BT30 spindle before ordering
speed_attachments.caveats: Small air-turbine power: micro finishing and light cuts only.

speed_attachments.name: HES510-BT30 motor spindle
speed_attachments.drive: electric motor spindle with its own controller; 340 W
speed_attachments.caveats: Separate controller and cable; the page does not describe automatic tool change compatibility, so verify against the machine.

speed_attachments.name: Typhoon HSM jet spindle (BT30 adaption)
speed_attachments.drive: driven by through-spindle coolant: 20 to 40 bar (290 to 580 psi), 12 L/min or more, main spindle locked
speed_attachments.caveats: Finishing and semi-finishing only, tools to 4 mm (5/32 in) per the operating conditions sheet; needs through-spindle coolant at 20 bar minimum at the spindle outlet; keep working rpm within 10 percent of idle rpm.
